info.name: SAP Crystal Reports RESTful Web Services Authentication Export API
Crystal Reports Export Report to Specified Format

params.name: reportId
params.description: Infostore object ID of the Crystal Report

params.name: mime_type
params.description: The MIME type of the desired export format

params.name: startPageNumber
params.description: Starting page number for the export (PDF only)

params.name: endPageNumber
params.description: Ending page number for the export (PDF only)

params.name: isCreateBookmarksFromGroupTree
params.description: Whether to create bookmarks from the group tree (PDF only)

items.docs: Exports a Crystal Report to the specified MIME type format. Supports PDF, CSV, Excel, Word, RTF, TTX, XML, plain text, and modern Excel (XLSX) formats.
